description: Schedule an HTTP POST of a JSON payload to a public URL: once, after delay_seconds or at the Unix time fire_at, 5 seconds to 24 hours ahead, or repeatedly every 60 to 86400 seconds until 24 hours after creation. The URL must resolve to a public address on port 80 or 443. The answer has schedule_id, which reads and cancels the job and should be kept private. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

payload.description: Any JSON, at most 32 KB. Defaults to {}.

name: schedule_webhook
title: Schedule a webhook
